info.name: OB4 Non-Reg: All API Success Flows
info.description:
Success-flow tests for every endpoint in apis/accounts/account-info-openapi.yaml and apis/payments/payment-initiation-openapi.yaml.

VARIABLES TO FILL IN (Collection > Variables):
- kid: JWK key id used to sign JWTs.
- jwk: the full JWK (as a JSON string) used for signing. Marked secret.
- pmlib_code: the JWT-signing library source code.
- client_id: your registered client id.
- is_host / is_port: Identity Server host/port (default localhost:9446).
- gw_host / gw_port: API gateway host/port (default localhost:8243).
- redirect_uri: OAuth redirect URI (default https://www.google.com).
- <type>_code (accounts_code, domestic_payment_code, domestic_scheduled_payment_code, domestic_standing_order_code, international_payment_code): leave blank, filled in manually during the Authorize step.

FILLED IN AUTOMATICALLY - leave blank:
- client_credentials_token and <type>_user_token: captured by the token requests.
- <type>_consent_id: extracted from the access token's consent_id claim by the Token Exchange step.
- <type>_id (account_id, domestic_payment_id, domestic_scheduled_payment_id, domestic_standing_order_id, international_payment_id): captured from the resource call that lists or creates the resource, not from the token.

FLOWS: each folder is one independent PAR -> Authorize -> Token -> Resource-call chain. Run requests within a folder in order:
1. PAR - signs and pushes the authorization request, capturing request_uri.
2. Authorize - open this request's Generated URL in a browser, log in, approve consent, then copy the code from the redirect into the matching <type>_code variable.
3. Token Exchange - exchanges the code for an access token and extracts the consent id into <type>_consent_id.
4+. Resource call(s) - the actual GET/POST/DELETE against the gateway, using the token (and consent id where the endpoint is keyed on the consent).

ORDER MATTERS in the Accounts folder: DELETE /consents/{ConsentId} runs LAST. It revokes the consent, so the account GETs above it stop being authorized.

item.name: 02. Authorize (manual consent) - copy code into accounts_code

exec: console.log('Open this request\'s Generated URL in an actual browser tab (Postman itself cannot render the login/consent screen), log in, and approve the consent.');

request.description: MANUAL STEP: open the Generated URL above in an actual browser tab (Postman can't render the login/consent screen), log in, and approve the consent. The redirect back to {{redirect_uri}} will carry the authorization result in the query string - since the signed request_object uses `response_mode: jwt` (JARM), that will be a single `response=<JWT>` parameter rather than a plain `code` parameter. Decode that JWT (e.g. paste it into jwt.io, or `atob()` its base64url payload segment yourself) and take its `code` claim - then paste that `code` value into the `accounts_code` collection variable before running the next request.
